text: Cyclone-related Government Risk Financing in Myanmar (2020–2025) is a set of public financial management instruments and regional risk-sharing arrangements designed to provide rapid, rules-based financing to prepare for and respond to cyclone impacts. It is anchored in Myanmar’s Disaster Management Law and Rules and connected to the ASEAN-led Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility (SEADRIF). The initiative aims to complement humanitarian funding and international support, focusing on wind damage, coastal storm surge, and severe flooding.
